item.title: Senior US soldier arrested by UK counter-terror police
item.body: A 41-year-old senior US soldier has been arrested on suspicion of offences under the National Security Act which relate to Russia, police have said.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🚨 Senior US soldier arrested by UK counter-terror police

A 41-year-old senior US soldier has been arrested on suspicion of offences under the National Security Act which relate to Russia, police have said.

Source: BBC/Guardian | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 10 November, 19:50
